title: Pronunciación de 읽다
chapter: Cambios fonológicos y reglas de 받침 — 음운 변동과 받침 규칙
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

**읽다** («leer») se pronuncia **[익따]**. En la posición de 읽다, la regla 11 reduce el grupo final ㄺ a [ㄱ] ante consonante; la regla 23 explica la pronunciación tensa de la ㄷ siguiente. La forma completa [익따] aparece confirmada directamente por NIKL.

#### Fuente y localizador

National Institute of Korean Language. (2018). *한국어 어문 규정집 [Korean Language Norms]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=DBD9A6A1F845C651FFC6B1864AAF1E59?c_file_name=1d66f826-df50-418d-a34f-2c38fa1fd45e_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EB%AC%B8%EA%B7%9C%EC%A0%95%EC%A7%91.pdf

National Institute of Korean Language, 2018, Korean Language Norms, 표준 발음법 §§11, 23, pp. 121, 127: ㄺ before a consonant is [ㄱ] and a following ㄷ after ㄱ(ㄺ) is tense.

National Institute of Korean Language. (2025). *초등 교과서 겹받침 발음 너무 헷갈립니다 [Pronunciation of complex codas in elementary textbooks]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/front/onlineQna/onlineQnaView.do?mn_id=&pageIndex=1&qna_seq=315279

Online Q&A “초등 교과서 겹받침 발음 너무 헷갈립니다,” answer dated 2025-05-23, answer item 1: 읽다 is [익따].
